item.title: Klarna stock slide extends into Friday following Q4 earnings
item.description: Shares of the neobank plummeted nearly 30% Thursday despite posting revenue over $1 billion as investors balked at up-front loan provision expenses that come with the expansion of Klarna's longer-term installment loans.

item.title: Banc of California names new head of payments
item.description: Banc of California appoints Chris Healy its new executive director and head of payments; Lia Fordjour is named chief financial officer of the American Bankers Association; Airwallex is the latest fintech to lean on sports sponsorships; and more in this week's banking news roundup.

item.title: Bessent: 'No one should expect' tariff revenue to decline
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said in a public appearance in Dallas Friday that the administration will seek alternative means of enacting the White House's tariff agenda after the Supreme Court struck down the tariffs as outside the bounds of the law.

item.title: Treasury issues new AI risk tools for banks
item.description: A public-private group led by the Treasury issued the first two of six planned resources to help banks navigate the risks and opportunities of AI.

item.title: Dropping tri-merge reports hikes mortgage risk, paper claims
item.description: Research from Andrew Davidson claims a significant number of mortgage borrowers would have a wide variance in credit score if less than three pulls are used.

item.title: Banks appeal ruling that upheld Illinois swipe fee ban
item.description: After a federal judge allowed a new state law to ban interchange fees on taxes and tips, a coalition of banks and credit unions struck back.

item.title: BofA sharpens focus on private credit, despite rising fears
item.description: The North Carolina-based megabank is making a $25 billion commitment to private credit — the latest signal that banks are undeterred, even as Wall Street raises alarm bells about the sector.

item.title: Mortgage trade groups back call for updates to Basel III
item.description: In a letter to regulators, the consortium of organizations recommended regulatory changes affecting a range of rules from risk weights to warehouse financing.

item.title: Trump boosts new tariff rate to 15% a day after announcing 10%
item.description: President rushes to preserve tariff agenda following Supreme Court ruling against his use of an emergency-powers law.

item.title: Karen Petrou, founder of Federal Financial Analytics, dies
item.description: A highly esteemed bank policy researcher and author, Petrou was an influential voice in Washington and sharp critic of the Federal Reserve's ultra-low interest rate policy after the 2008 financial crisis.
